els.description: Public artwork by Emily Clanton. Hand-twisted fabric cordage assembled into a proof-of-concept twine mural for ArtFields 2022 at the TRAX Visual Art Center, demonstrating how repurposed materials can become collective public art.
els.name: Energetic Exchange (twine mural)

els.description: Public artwork by Emily Clanton. Relocated twine mural made from hand-twisted, repurposed fabric strips. First shown at ArtFields 2022 and later installed at the Greater Lake City Community Resource Center as part of UF Arts in Medicine practicum.
els.name: Energetic Exchange (Twine Mural)

els.description: Public artwork by Emily Clanton. “Heart/Hands,” a 9×7 ft installation of 63 handmade papercrete tiles shown at ArtFields 2019 in downtown Lake City. Created as a memorial to her father, the work links grief, care, and community health.
els.name: Heart/Hands

els.description: Public artwork by Emily Clanton. Mixed media portrait installed on an exterior brick wall for ArtFields 2018 in Lake City, SC. Made from paper, acrylic, and plexiglass, the work highlighted material experimentation and contributed to civic revitalization.
